2026 Orange Shirt Day event list

Thousands of people across Turtle Island will gather to remember, grieve, educate, mourn those who survived and are victims of Indian boarding and residential schools
by ICT Staff September 28, 2026September 28, 2026

Share this:

September 30 is the National Day of Remembrance for victims and survivors of Indian boarding schools and residential boarding schools across the United States and Canada. 

The day is also known as Orange Shirt Day or National Day for Truth and Reconciliation where hundreds of events are scheduled in both countries throughout the week to honor those who attended and the many who never came home. 

Read the latest stories here and here on ICT’s coverage of Indian boarding schools.

ICT has organized a list of events held on or around this year’s Orange Shirt Day.
